items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Scotty played with the small group until he went in the service and then after he went in the service, I replaced him

ctx.x: Uh-huh, ORVILLE MINOR. And so I -- Scotty played with the small group until he went in the service and then after he went in the service, I replaced him, you know. He went in the service, oh, I guess he must have went in the service as early as '40, 1940.
Well, who sort of decided the style of your band?
